title: Rose Pavilion

services.name: Rose Pavilion Rentals
services.desc: Join us for an evening of gardening, giving back, and connecting with your neighbors during our Fall 2026 edition of Neighbor Nights! This fall, we’re bringing Neighbor Nights to the Westside of the Charleston peninsula, with two opportunities to get involved at Rose Pavilion at Hampton Park and Allan Park. From 5:00-7:00 p.m., neighbors will come together for a fun evening of hands-on gardening and park beautification while connecting with others in the community and giving back to these local green spaces. blurb: Nestled within one of Charleston’s largest and most beloved parks, the Rose Pavilion at Hampton Park offers a charming and versatile gathering space for the community. Named for the park’s historic heirloom rose collection, the Pavilion serves as a welcoming venue for family celebrations, social gatherings, and community events.
